summary: Banco Macro S.A. disclosed via Form 6-K a CNV relevant-event notice that it repurchased 21,598 Class B common shares (one vote each, Ps$1 par) at an average price of Ps$9,777.136 per share, for an aggregate Ps$211,166,590, executed under Section 64 of Argentine Law 26,831 and applicable CNV rules. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium was named. The filing is a routine open-market buyback notification rather than a formal tender offer; the US-equivalent read is an issuer share repurchase disclosure. Watch cumulative repurchase pace, treasury-share overhang, and any subsequent program expansion.
